nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and mutable via transferOwnership/acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership handover (acceptOwnership).
Public ERC20 token symbol set once in the ContractDeployer constructor.
Public ERC20 token name set once in the ContractDeployer constructor.
Public token decimals used to scale the initial total supply.
Cached total token supply computed in the constructor as totalSupply*10**decimals.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for owner initialisation, balance debits, allowance keys and authorization checks.
Checked addition helper requiring the result to be >= the first operand.
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a before subtracting.
Checked multiplication helper validating overflow via c/a == b.
Checked division helper requiring a non-zero denominator.
Deploy-time constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that immediately overwrites owner with the supplied address and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Pending-owner handover step; requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that initialises metadata, mints the whole supply to _owner and calls transferOwnership.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw, unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without checking the current allowance and emits Approval.
Debits 'from' balance and msg.sender allowance and credits 'to' using SafeMath helpers.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call into ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval before returning.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts so the token contract never accepts ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer of tokens held by this contract.
External call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed by approveAndCall after state writes; the spender is attacker-controlled.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) executed by transferAnyERC20Token against an arbitrary, attacker-suppliable token address.
Raw arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply without SafeMath protection.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, letting the deployer caller control ownership.
Constructor writes the untrusted caller address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, so msg.sender must equal owner to reach the external call.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is moved.
transferOwnership assigns the _newOwner argument directly to owner without a two-step confirmation.
acceptOwnership resets the newOwner state variable to address(0) after transfer.
The token constructor invokes transferOwnership(_owner) during deployment.
Constructor argument _symbol is stored into the symbol state variable.
Constructor argument _name is stored into the name state variable.
Constructor argument _decimals is stored into the decimals state variable.
_totalSupply is computed as totalSupply*10**uint(decimals) using unchecked exponentiation/multiplication rather than safeMul.
Constructor argument _owner receives the entire minted supply in balances[_owner].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] for the supplied account parameter.
transfer credits the user-supplied recipient parameter in balances[to].
transfer debits the user-supplied tokens amount from balances[msg.sender].
safeAdd is used to increase entries of the balances mapping inside transfer/transferFrom.
safeSub is used to decrease entries of the balances mapping inside transfer/transferFrom.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller identity the source of funds.
transfer writes updated sender and recipient balances into the balances state mapping.
approve writes the spender parameter as the key of the allowed mapping.
approve writes the tokens parameter as the allowance value for the spender.
approve indexes the allowed mapping with msg.sender as the token owner.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the user-supplied source address.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the user-supplied destination address.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter for both balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], tying the spender identity to the allowance key.
transferFrom decreases the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
transferFrom updates both source and destination entries of the balances mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the supplied owner parameter.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the supplied spender parameter.
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter both as allowance key and as external call target.
approveAndCall stores the tokens parameter as the allowance and forwards it to receiveApproval.
approveAndCall forwards the raw data parameter into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender into receiveApproval.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed state mapping before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token casts the owner-supplied tokenAddress parameter and calls transfer on it.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the tokens parameter into the external ERC20 transfer.
safeAdd computes c = a + b from its two parameters.
safeAdd computes c = a + b from its two parameters.
safeSub computes c = a - b from its two parameters.
safeSub computes c = a - b from its two parameters.
safeMul computes c = a * b from its two parameters.
safeMul computes c = a * b from its two parameters.
safeDiv computes c = a / b from its two parameters.
safeDiv computes c = a / b from its two parameters.
totalSupply performs the raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without the SafeMath wrapper.
The unchecked subtraction reads balances[address(0)] directly, so the result can underflow if that balance is non-zero larger than _totalSupply.
The unsafe arithmetic result is returned as the contract's reported total supply.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call after writing the allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches the external ERC20 transfer call on the arbitrary token address.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall while the allowance has already been written, enabling unexpected state changes.
The attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter approve/transferFrom during receiveApproval to manipulate or consume allowances.
Reentry from the receiveApproval callback can invoke transferFrom and move balances mid-execution.
The arbitrary tokenAddress contract called by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the owner-controlled rescue function and any other unprotected entry point.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only carries the value written to the owner state variable by transferOwnership, so it collapses into that core function.
The _symbol parameter is immediately stored into the symbol state variable by the ContractDeployer constructor.
The _name parameter is immediately stored into the name state variable by the ContractDeployer constructor.
The _decimals parameter is immediately stored into the decimals state variable by the ContractDeployer constructor.
The totalSupply parameter is consumed by the constructor's unchecked supply computation.
The _owner parameter is consumed by the constructor to seed balances and to hand over ownership.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used to index the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
The to parameter is only used as the recipient key inside transfer.
The tokens parameter is only used as the transferred amount inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
The tokens parameter is only used as the allowance value inside approve.
The from parameter is only used as the debited balance key inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is only used as the credited balance key inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only used as the debited amount inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter is the allowance key and the external callback target of approveAndCall, and drives the unsafe external call operation.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value and callback payload of approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter is cast into the unsafe external ERC20Interface call inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the unsafe external ERC20 transfer inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Operand a exists only to compute c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Operand b exists only to compute c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Operand a exists only to compute c = a - b inside safeSub.
Operand b exists only to compute c = a - b inside safeSub.
Operand a exists only to compute c = a * b inside safeMul.
Operand b exists only to compute c = a * b inside safeMul.
Operand a exists only to compute c = a / b inside safeDiv.
Operand b exists only to compute c = a / b inside safeDiv.
